WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'calendar Sep 2026' AS label, SUM(net_sales) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web, MIN(business_date) AS mn, MAX(business_date) AS mx, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'P05', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), COUNT(*)
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control Sep', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), COUNT(*)
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control P05', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), COUNT(*)
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_returns,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE w.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS web_lines_no_order,
 (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30') AS excluded_999_zz,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale
